title: MatReplace: A Reference-Free, Conditioning-Aligned Benchmark for Material Replacement in Interior Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2608.24107v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Material replacement is a common interior-design operation: changing the material of a selected surface while preserving its geometry, surroundings, and illumination. Despite its commercial relevance, no public benchmark isolates this task, and evaluating it is challenging. Reference-based metrics penalize valid outputs in this inherently one-to-many setting, favor the style of the reference generator, and cannot fairly compare editors that receive different forms of guidance. We introduce MatReplace, a reference-free benchmark that evaluates edits along four verifiable dimensions: local material correctness, global lighting harmony, outside preservation, and inside structure. It defines three tracks that vary one conditioning signal at a time: (A) instruction only, (B) instruction plus region mask, and (C) material reference image instead of instruction. Our results reveal a clear divide between naming and visually grounding materials

translated_title: MatReplace：室内场景材质替换的无参考、条件对齐基准
translated_abstract: 摘要：材质替换是一种常见的室内设计操作：在保持所选表面的几何形状、周围环境和照明不变的情况下，更改其材质。尽管其具有商业相关性，但目前尚无公开基准专门针对此任务，且评估该任务颇具挑战性。基于参考的指标会在此固有的一对多场景中惩罚有效输出，偏向参考生成器的风格，并且无法公平比较接收不同形式指导的编辑器。我们引入了MatReplace，这是一个无参考基准，它沿四个可验证维度评估编辑效果：局部材质正确性、全局光照和谐性、外部区域保持性和内部结构完整性。该基准定义了三个轨迹，每次仅变化一个条件信号：（A）仅指令，（B）指令加区域掩码，以及（C）材质参考图像代替指令。我们的结果揭示了在命名和视觉定位材质之间存在明显差距。
tldr: 我们提出了MatReplace，这是首个无参考的室内场景材质替换基准，通过四个可验证维度和三种条件轨迹，系统评估编辑质量并揭示命名与视觉定位之间的差距。
en_tdlr: We introduce MatReplace, the first reference-free benchmark for material replacement in interior scenes, evaluating edits along four verifiable dimensions and three conditioning tracks, revealing a divide between naming and visually grounding materials.
